h1: Can I build a carport in Newton, MA, and what permits are required?
title: Newton Carport Permits: Structure, Setback and Building Rules
description: Find out why a permanent carport needs a building and zoning review and which design conditions should be checked.
short_answer: A new permanent carport should be reviewed by Newton ISD as a building or structure project and checked against the property's accessory-building or principal-building zoning rules. Newton's accessory-building setbacks generally include 5 feet from side and rear lot lines and 5 feet from the principal building. The exact treatment depends on the carport's design and location.

facts.text: The state building code requires a permit before regulated construction of a building or structure.
Newton's accessory-building ordinance generally requires setbacks from side and rear lot lines and separation from the principal building.

qa.q: Is an open-sided carport automatically exempt from building and zoning rules?
qa.a: The cited sources do not establish a general carport exemption. Confirm how Newton classifies the proposed permanent structure and which permits apply.
